text:
Maria: seeing a sharp jump in 502/504s on hosted inference since the 08:03 canary deploy, ~12% errors over last 5m, customers reporting timeouts
DeployBot: canary deploy started by jenna at 08:03 UTC, image: inference:v3.4.1-canary
Sam (oncall): looking now, can you paste the service/route id?
Maria: route: /v1/generate -> rp-service-prod-1, service tag: weight=0.05 for canary
Nikhil: I see increased 504s between gateway -> rp-service-prod-1 pods, also some 502s with connection reset in envoy logs
Laila (support): multiple customers (acct: acme-inc, devtools) opened P1 escalations complaining about timeouts and failed requests, support is triaging
Aaron (product): are we sure the canary weight is correct? I thought we rolled a staggered 1% then 5%
Maria: config says target=5% but rollout controller shows 20% on a subset of regions (us-east-1)
Jenna (sre): that sounds like the routing config patch didn't honor region selectors; possibly parameter parsing bug in rollout service
Sam (oncall): collecting pod logs, running quick repro with a synthetic request to /v1/generate to see latency and error output
Sam (oncall): repro shows backend returns 200, but gateway times out waiting for KV cache warmup and returns 504 after 15s
Nikhil: KV cache warm path increased tail latency due to changed kernel flags in v3.4.1 canary, older model variants handled it fine
Maria: customers also seeing spikes in token billing anomalies (duplicate attempts) — support forwarded some request IDs
Laila (support): sample request ids: req_3a9f, req_3ad2, req_3b11 — all show repeated client retries in logs
Jenna (sre): deploy rollback recommended. We need coordinated rollback across regions to avoid split-brain (don't rollback only us-east).
Sam (oncall): +1 — plan: pause traffic to canary via routing API, then roll back image on deployment if pause doesn't reduce errors within 2m
Maria: can we pause just the faulty param that enables new kernel switches? which flag is that?
Nikhil: it's ENV INFERENCE_KERNEL_MODE=fastpath_v2, set in canary config map
Aaron (product): if we toggle the flag off does it keep canary image but preserve other changes? we can attempt soft mitigation first
Jenna (sre): yes, patching configmap is faster than full rollback. I'll apply a rollback-safe patch to set INFERENCE_KERNEL_MODE=legacy for canary targets
Sam (oncall): commands I'll run (dry run first):
```bash
# pause traffic to canary
curl -X POST "https://orchestrator.internal/api/v1/route/pause" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","tag":"canary"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# patch configmap
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/rp-service-prod-1 INFERENCE_KERNEL_MODE=legacy --record
```
Maria: patch applied?
Jenna (sre): applying now in all regions, will wait for propagation and monitor 2m window
DeployBot: pause request accepted, request_id=pb-9832, propagation started
Sam (oncall): monitoring metrics: error% dropping from 12% -> 3% in us-east-1 after config toggle, overall platform down to 2.1%
Laila (support): sending update to affected customers: "We applied a mitigation and are seeing error rates fall; we'll follow up once fully stable" :thumbsup:
Aaron (product): we'll schedule a deeper postmortem and block further canary escalation until kernel flag regression is investigated
Nikhil: root cause hypothesis: new kernel fastpath increases cold KV cache latency under certain request patterns, causing gateway timeouts at SLO edge. We'll reproduce with controlled load and trace KV cache warm steps
Maria: assigning owners for postmortem: Nikhil (root cause), Jenna (rollback/runbook), Sam (monitoring/alerts), Laila (customer comms), Aaron (product decision)
Jenna (sre): creating incident doc and runbook update now
Sam (oncall): closing loop: full rollback not needed after flag flip, keep canary image in place but with legacy kernel flag; will block further rollout until fix merged
DeployBot: deploy event: configmap patch rolled to all regions at 08:11 UTC, event_id=db-52611-flagpatch
Maria: thanks team — keeping this thread pinned for postmortem notes and timeline
Laila (support): I'll collect the customer request IDs and escalate billing review if duplicate charges observed
Aaron (product): follow-up: schedule a short retro and determine whether to add canary gating for kernel flags specifically
Nikhil: I'll post repro steps + perf script to #eng-ml once validated
Jenna (sre): incident status: mitigated, monitoring for regression for next 60m
Maria: last update: error% stable ~1.2%, no new P1s in last 10m, closing active escalation but keeping incident doc open
